page.layout: One printed page, single column of text. Above the text a decorative woodcut border. Below the text a signature-like star and page number "2" at the foot right. No margin notes.

main_text.head: ILLVSTRISSIMO ET POTENTISSIMO PRINCIPI AC DOMINO, DOMINO Friderico, Comiti Palatino ad Rhenum, Bauariæ Duci, &c. Romani imperij Electori primario, Domino suo clementissimo S. P.

p.i: ETVS verbũ est, illu-strissime Princeps, Patria est vbicumque est bene, Teucro Telamonis filio attributum: multisque seculis coprobatum. nam fortis animi excelsiq; videtur esse, vt cetera incommoda, sic etiam exilium, æquo animo ferre: ingrataéq; patriæ, tanquam nouercæ, iniurias contemnere. Verùm, ego longè esse arbitror secus. nam si parentum mores, atq; adeò asperitatem ini-

page.notes: The initial "V" is a large woodcut initial, transcribed as "ETVS" joined to it: the printed opening reads "VETVS" with the V decorative. The catchword "ni-" is the hyphenated line-end at the foot of the text. Printed "coprobatum" and "secus" transcribed as printed. The star mark at the foot is a printer's signature mark, not transcribed.
